items.name: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
items.blurb: The tune is the French song "Ah! vous dirai-je, maman" (1761); the words are from a poem by Jane Taylor (1806).
lyrics: How I wonder what you are
Up above the world so high
Like a diamond in the sky

audio.credit: Traditional (composer); transcribed by Clued from public-domain sources; Salamander Grand Piano samples by Alexander Holm (CC BY 3.0)

items.name: Frère Jacques
items.blurb: A French round from the 1700s, sung in English as "Are You Sleeping?".
lyrics: Are you sleeping, are you sleeping
Morning bells are ringing, morning bells are ringing
Ding, dang, dong. Ding, dang, dong.
